# Thermal Storage Tank (ThermalStorageTank)

> **Class**: `ThermalStorageTank` | **Module**: `energysim.models.hvac_thermal` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Sensible hot/cold water Thermal Energy Storage (TES), energy-bucket model.

The tank is a single energy store: SoC integrates the commanded thermal
flow (positive = charging) minus a standing loss proportional to SoC. There
is *no* stratification, thermocline, temperature or flow-temperature
dependence. Requests are scaled so SoC stays in [0, 1], so stored energy
is exactly the integral of ``Q_actual_MW - Q_loss_MW``.

Validity: capacity-level studies at hours-to-days timescales.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'ThermalTank'` | - | Unique component name identifier |
| `capacity_mwh_th` | `float` | `50.0` | MWh_th | - |
| `max_flow_rate_mw_th` | `float` | `10.0` | MW_th | - |
| `loss_pct_per_day` | `float` | `2.0` | %/day | - |
| `soc_init` | `float` | `0.5` | 1 | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Q_cmd_MW` | MW | - |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Q_actual_MW` | MW | Thermal power actually charged (+) or discharged (-) |
| `SoC` | 1 | Thermal state of charge |
| `Q_loss_MW` | MW | Standing thermal loss |

## Validity and notes

Validity: capacity-level studies at hours-to-days timescales.

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import ThermalStorageTank

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('thermalstoragetank', model=ThermalStorageTank(), outputs=['Q_actual_MW', 'SoC', 'Q_loss_MW'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['thermalstoragetank'].tail(2))
```
